answer: Noise token injection at the summit: each block hash seeds a pseudo-random token airdrop. A zephyr of entropy drifts through the reward pool, so splitting one identity into many yields uncorrelated payouts. The prism separates honest miners from farm clusters, since real hashrate correlates with token value but fake identities don't. Break-even: an attacker needs >51% hashrate to force favorable noise, costing more than the sybil rewards returned.
